item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 15/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry easterly airstream, the weather will be mainly fine over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Upper-air disturbances are expected to bring showers to southern China over the weekend. A broad trough of low pressure will affect the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea early next week. The weather will be unsettled over the region. There will be thunderstorms and more showers.
